Unique Research · Insight / Awards · November 17, 2022

4th Unique Awards (非凡奖 since 2019) jury reveal continues. Submissions: ~200 cases from 100+ brands/vendors; first dedicated go-global track = 41.3%; ~1/3 product / 2/3 service. Ceremony targeted early December. Jury pool of 100 across enterprise / brand / investor / academia / media committees scores online for authority and advance.

Second guest batch: 肖欢 · 吉田士誠 · 杨蓉 · 林悦 · 茹炯 · 俞湘华 · 林雨新 · 刘明 · 周璐 · 严颢 · 李伟斌 · 王政 · 韩一 · 石承泰 · 杨波 · 廖骏 · 王彬 · 马成 · 魏方丹 · 吴孝明 — brand, MarTech, investment, and media leaders. Full bios/headshots in CN gallery — attach on ingest. Full bilingual titles, career notes, and headshots in the Chinese source gallery — attach on ingest.
